text.arabic_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that links and resumes the discourse
words.prose: The opening conjunction does more than continue a sentence. It carries the reader from the prior statement of unaltered divine pattern into this event as proof, while also giving the ayah a new declarative launch.

topics.headline: resumptive opening proof-link
topics.summary: The opening conjunction does more than continue a sentence. It carries the reader from the prior statement of unaltered divine pattern into this event as proof, while also giving the ayah a new declarative launch.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as a concrete exhibit of the prior unchangeable divine pattern, while still launching a fresh declaration.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on resumptive and coordinative force after 48:23; local clause evidence allows both linkage and fresh declaration.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun foregrounding the actor before the relative predicate
words.prose: The independent pronoun places the actor first, before the restraining act appears. That fronting keeps the event from reading as circumstance or human initiative, and it echoes the same formula used for divine intervention at 48:4.

topics.headline: fronted divine agency
topics.summary: The independent pronoun places the actor first, before the restraining act appears. That fronting keeps the event from reading as circumstance or human initiative, and it echoes the same formula used for divine intervention at 48:4.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine agency before any human conflict is narrated.
topics.reason: The nominal opening and same-surah formula support an agency-focused reading of the pronoun.

words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun functioning as predicate of the fronted pronoun
words.prose: The relative pronoun makes the following restraint clause the identifying predicate. The opening is therefore not bare narrative; it defines the divine actor through this precise act of restraint.

topics.headline: relative predicate defines through the act
topics.summary: The relative pronoun makes the following restraint clause the identifying predicate. The opening is therefore not bare narrative; it defines the divine actor through this precise act of restraint.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God is identified here by the specific act of restraining, not by an abstract title.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the relative pronoun the predicate of the fronted pronoun, and the rows identify the restrictive force of that construction.

words.gloss_range: locally narrowed to completed physical restraint of hostile and retaliatory reach
words.root_gloss_range: broad withholding, checking, folding-back, desisting, and blindness field; local hands-collocation selects restraint of reach while preserving folded-back pressure
words.prose: The verb is a completed direct act that governs both sets of hands without repeating the predicate. Its broader withholding and folding-back field stays visible as recoil of reach, while the local objects narrow it to mutual restraint rather than an activated blindness sense.

topics.headline: single bilateral act of restrained reach
topics.summary: The verb is a completed direct act that governs both sets of hands without repeating the predicate. Its broader withholding and folding-back field stays visible as recoil of reach, while the local objects narrow it to mutual restraint rather than an activated blindness sense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one completed divine verb folds both sides of possible violence into a single restrained event.
topics.reason: The local verb governs two hand objects and matching separation phrases; lexical rows about folding survive, but the blindness branch is only a contrast with the final sight attribute.

words.gloss_range: opponents collective hands as instruments, reach, and capacity under restraint
words.root_gloss_range: hand field including bodily hand, power, control, favor, and reach; local phrase selects owned opposing reach
words.prose: The first hand phrase names the opponents owned capacity as the first object of restraint. Hand as bodily instrument and power is active here, but the suffix and following separation phrase narrow it to their reach being diverted from the addressed group.

topics.headline: opponents hands as owned reach
topics.summary: The first hand phrase names the opponents owned capacity as the first object of restraint. Hand as bodily instrument and power is active here, but the suffix and following separation phrase narrow it to their reach being diverted from the addressed group.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first restrained capacity belongs specifically to the opposing group and moves in a them-to-you vector.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix, object relation, and mirrored phrase support owned opposing reach; broader hand-power senses are locally constrained by the restraint construction.

words.gloss_range: separation preposition with second-person plural endpoint
words.prose: The prepositional form marks the protected endpoint inside the word itself. It says the hostile reach is diverted away from you, and it waits for the later reversed phrase to complete the mutual pattern.

topics.headline: away-from-you protection vector
topics.summary: The prepositional form marks the protected endpoint inside the word itself. It says the hostile reach is diverted away from you, and it waits for the later reversed phrase to complete the mutual pattern.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that protection is encoded as separation: hostile reach is moved away from the addressed community.
topics.reason: The rows and attachment evidence identify the preposition as governed by the restraint verb and as the first half of a mirrored separation frame.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the second hand object under the same verb
words.prose: This conjunction does not start a new event. It hinges the second hand phrase to the first under the same restraining verb, turning the syntax from protection alone into bilateral governance.

topics.headline: hinge of bilateral restraint
topics.summary: This conjunction does not start a new event. It hinges the second hand phrase to the first under the same restraining verb, turning the syntax from protection alone into bilateral governance.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction is the pivot where a one-sided rescue becomes a balanced restraint of both sides.
topics.reason: Local attachment makes the second hand phrase coordinated with the first object, and the CRITICAL rows identify the conjunction as the symmetry pivot.

words.gloss_range: addressed group hands as owned agency and reach under the same restraint
words.root_gloss_range: hand field including bodily hand, power, control, favor, and reach; local phrase selects the addressees own restrained capacity
words.prose: The second hand phrase makes the addressed group patients of the same divine restraint. Its matching form and reversed suffix do not merely balance style; they show that believers own reach is also kept back from the opponents.

topics.headline: believers hands restrained too
topics.summary: The second hand phrase makes the addressed group patients of the same divine restraint. Its matching form and reversed suffix do not merely balance style; they show that believers own reach is also kept back from the opponents.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressed believers are not only protected; their own capacity for retaliation is also restrained.
topics.reason: The second object relation and reversed suffixes support local bilateral restraint, while broader hand-power meanings remain narrowed to agency and reach.

words.gloss_range: separation preposition with third-person plural endpoint
words.prose: This phrase completes the reversal begun earlier: their hands away from you, your hands away from them. The endpoint turns victory into disciplined non-retaliation rather than unchecked dominance.

topics.headline: away-from-them closure
topics.summary: This phrase completes the reversal begun earlier: their hands away from you, your hands away from them. The endpoint turns victory into disciplined non-retaliation rather than unchecked dominance.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the mirrored restraint frame closes only when the believers reach is also directed away from them.
topics.reason: The governed prepositional complement and chiastic CRITICAL rows make this the closing endpoint of the mutual separation frame.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition attached to the following construct phrase
words.prose: The single-letter preposition compresses the locative relation and delays the named place until the next words. The restraint is not left floating; it is being fixed inside a concrete setting.

topics.headline: locative compression before the place
topics.summary: The single-letter preposition compresses the locative relation and delays the named place until the next words. The restraint is not left floating; it is being fixed inside a concrete setting.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the event is anchored in place before the place name is even fully named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the following construct phrase as the place of the restraint, matching the rows on locative and circumstantial force.

words.gloss_range: construct noun for the interior or belly of the named place
words.root_gloss_range: belly, womb, interior, hiddenness, and clan field; local construct selects spatial interior while retaining hidden-inside imagery
words.prose: The noun makes the location bodily: the event occurs in the citys interior, not just at a point on a map. The wider belly and hiddenness field remains as imagery, but the construct with the place name narrows it to spatial interior.

topics.headline: body-interior location
topics.summary: The noun makes the location bodily: the event occurs in the citys interior, not just at a point on a map. The wider belly and hiddenness field remains as imagery, but the construct with the place name narrows it to spatial interior.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the place is imagined as an interior, so the restraint happens inside the citys inner body rather than at an abstract location.
topics.reason: The locative attachment and construct relation select place, while the CRITICAL rows preserve the body-interior and hiddenness pressure.

words.gloss_range: proper place name dependent in the construct phrase
words.root_gloss_range: disputed place-name derivations may suggest drawing-in or sacred-place naming; local grammar uses the proper noun as a fixed location
words.prose: The proper name fixes the interior phrase as a named sacred location. Disputed derivational suggestions can color the sense of a drawing-in place, but the local function is narrower: the named city completes the nested location of the restraint.

topics.headline: named sacred place in an interior construct
topics.summary: The proper name fixes the interior phrase as a named sacred location. Disputed derivational suggestions can color the sense of a drawing-in place, but the local function is narrower: the named city completes the nested location of the restraint.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rare proper name closes the spatial beat with nested specificity: restraint inside the interior of Makkah.
topics.reason: The word is a proper noun in the construct phrase; etymological and alternate-name rows are useful but cannot override the local place-name role.

words.gloss_range: preposition opening a compound temporal phrase
words.prose: The preposition begins the aftermath chain. It carries source-like movement into temporal sequence, so the verse turns from where restraint happened to after what decisive event it happened.

topics.headline: start of aftermath timing
topics.summary: The preposition begins the aftermath chain. It carries source-like movement into temporal sequence, so the verse turns from where restraint happened to after what decisive event it happened.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the temporal turn from the event-location to what happened after victory was granted.
topics.reason: Rows and attachment evidence make the word part of the compound temporal phrase governed with the following noun.

words.gloss_range: singular construct aftermath marker governing the following clause
words.root_gloss_range: distance and posteriority field; local construct selects temporal aftermath rather than spatial distance
words.prose: The word binds posteriority to the following clause. Its distance-root pressure remains as a sense of separation from the victory moment, while the local construction selects aftermath rather than mere physical distance.

topics.headline: posteriority bound to one victory clause
topics.summary: The word binds posteriority to the following clause. Its distance-root pressure remains as a sense of separation from the victory moment, while the local construction selects aftermath rather than mere physical distance.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the restraint is placed after a specific granted-victory clause, not in vague later time.
topics.reason: The genitive temporal construction and maṣdar-clause complement narrow the broad distance field to a specific after-event sequence.

words.gloss_range: subordinating and nominalizing particle before the victory verb
words.prose: The particle turns the following victory action into the complement of the temporal phrase. It is the small bridge that lets the verse say after Gods granting-victory, not simply narrate a second main event.

topics.headline: nominalizing bridge to victory
topics.summary: The particle turns the following victory action into the complement of the temporal phrase. It is the small bridge that lets the verse say after Gods granting-victory, not simply narrate a second main event.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the victory verb is packaged as the content of the after-phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the following clause as governed by the temporal noun, and the CRITICAL rows identify the particle as the bridge.

words.gloss_range: completed Form IV causing the addressees to prevail over the opponents
words.root_gloss_range: nail, claw, holding-fast, attaining, and victory field; local Form IV selects caused mastery over opponents while preserving grip imagery
words.prose: The Form IV verb presents victory as caused for the addressees, with the following superiority phrase naming those over whom it is granted. The claw or nail image gives mastery a grip-like feel, but the surrounding hand-restraint keeps that victory suspended rather than unleashed.

topics.headline: caused mastery held in suspension
topics.summary: The Form IV verb presents victory as caused for the addressees, with the following superiority phrase naming those over whom it is granted. The claw or nail image gives mastery a grip-like feel, but the surrounding hand-restraint keeps that victory suspended rather than unleashed.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that victory is granted as caused superiority, yet the surrounding restraint keeps that dominance from becoming free violence.
topics.reason: The local form, object suffix, and superiority complement select caused victory; lexical claw imagery survives as color under that narrowed sense.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus third-person plural suffix marking superiority over opponents
words.prose: The phrase lands the temporal victory clause by naming the defeated endpoint. Its preposition gives the victory vertical overness, not just contact with an opponent.

topics.headline: superiority over the defeated party
topics.summary: The phrase lands the temporal victory clause by naming the defeated endpoint. Its preposition gives the victory vertical overness, not just contact with an opponent.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the victory clause lands in vertical overness: the addressees are made superior over them.
topics.reason: The phrase is the governed complement of the victory verb, and rows converge on superiority as the local force.

words.gloss_range: conjunction introducing the closing attribute clause
words.prose: This conjunction opens the closing attribute clause while keeping it attached to the event report. It marks the shift from restrained hands and granted victory to the theological seal that interprets them.

topics.headline: event-to-attribute transition
topics.summary: This conjunction opens the closing attribute clause while keeping it attached to the event report. It marks the shift from restrained hands and granted victory to the theological seal that interprets them.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final conjunction moves from narrated event to divine attribute seal.
topics.reason: The clause boundary evidence and same-surah refrain rows support a transition into the closing divine-attribute formula.

words.gloss_range: perfect copular verb in a divine attribute formula
words.root_gloss_range: being, existing, becoming, and persistence field; local divine-attribute construction selects established persistence
words.prose: The copula is formally perfect, but in this divine-attribute formula it establishes persistent sight rather than a merely past observation. It turns the specific Makkah restraint into a general statement of divine oversight.

topics.headline: persistent attribute closure
topics.summary: The copula is formally perfect, but in this divine-attribute formula it establishes persistent sight rather than a merely past observation. It turns the specific Makkah restraint into a general statement of divine oversight.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final sight is framed as an enduring divine attribute, not as a one-time past observation.
topics.reason: The subject-predicate construction and divine formula narrow the broad being field to enduring attribute predication.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as nominative subject of the copula
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name with derivational discussions around worship, devotion, refuge, and orientation; local grammar selects the named subject of sight
words.prose: The explicit name resets the divine subject before the sight attribute. Derivational discussions may enrich the name, but the local payoff is grammatical and theological: the bearer of the final seeing is named rather than merely implied.

topics.headline: explicit divine name before sight
topics.summary: The explicit name resets the divine subject before the sight attribute. Derivational discussions may enrich the name, but the local payoff is grammatical and theological: the bearer of the final seeing is named rather than merely implied.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing attribute is attached to the explicit divine name, not left to an implied subject.
topics.reason: The word is the nominative subject of the copula; broader derivational disputes are narrowed to the proper-name subject function.

words.gloss_range: preposition scoping the final perception attribute to the following relative deed phrase
words.prose: The preposition attaches the final attribute to a deed-domain instead of leaving sight abstract. The repeated formula from 48:11 returns with a different attribute, so the same field of what you do is now foregrounded as seen.

topics.headline: deed-domain of sight
topics.summary: The preposition attaches the final attribute to a deed-domain instead of leaving sight abstract. The repeated formula from 48:11 returns with a different attribute, so the same field of what you do is now foregrounded as seen.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final attribute is scoped to what people do, and that the same deed-domain formula receives a seeing attribute here instead of the awareness attribute at 48:11.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the relative pronoun in the scope phrase; formula rows are narrowed to the repeated deed-domain contrast with 48:11.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun governed by the preposition and heading the action clause
words.prose: The pronoun links the preposition to the action clause and keeps the object of sight open. Whether heard as relative what or noun-like doing, the local effect is breadth: the watched field is not enumerated.

topics.headline: open scope of what is done
topics.summary: The pronoun links the preposition to the action clause and keeps the object of sight open. Whether heard as relative what or noun-like doing, the local effect is breadth: the watched field is not enumerated.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine sight covers an open whatever-you-do field rather than a listed set of deeds.
topics.reason: The grammar makes the word both governed by the preposition and head of the following relative content; ambiguity is narrowed to broad deed scope.

words.gloss_range: imperfect second-person plural active doing inside the relative scope phrase
words.root_gloss_range: purposeful doing, making, practicing, producing, and deed-accountability field; local imperfect selects ongoing addressed action
words.prose: The imperfect verb shifts from completed divine acts to ongoing action by the addressed group. Variant person evidence shows how the watched party could shift, but the local reading keeps you plural in view, and the verbal form presents deeds as active doing rather than an abstract noun.

topics.headline: ongoing addressed action under sight
topics.summary: The imperfect verb shifts from completed divine acts to ongoing action by the addressed group. Variant person evidence shows how the watched party could shift, but the local reading keeps you plural in view, and the verbal form presents deeds as active doing rather than an abstract noun.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that after completed restraint and victory, the close turns to the addressees ongoing deeds as the last named field before divine sight.
topics.reason: The canonical form is second-person plural imperfect completing the relative clause; qiraat rows are retained as person contrast but narrowed to the local reading.

words.gloss_range: accusative qualitative predicate naming divine sight as the final attribute
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, insight, clear perception, and expert discernment field; local adjective selects stable divine perception over deeds
words.prose: The final adjective completes the copular clause and makes divine sight the ayahs landing point. Its field spans sight, insight, and expert perception; that matters here because the interior location is answered by a seeing attribute that penetrates what is hidden, and the repeated 48:11 formula now foregrounds visibility rather than awareness.

topics.headline: final penetrative sight
topics.summary: The final adjective completes the copular clause and makes divine sight the ayahs landing point. Its field spans sight, insight, and expert perception; that matters here because the interior location is answered by a seeing attribute that penetrates what is hidden, and the repeated 48:11 formula now foregrounds visibility rather than awareness.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on enduring divine sight that sees deeds and penetrates the hidden interior where restraint occurred.
topics.reason: The word is the accusative predicate of the copula; lexical and formula rows survive as stable perception, interior-penetrating sight, and contrast with 48:11.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired hand objects are restrained only after the clause in which God grants prevalence, and the ayah closes by placing intentional action under divine discernment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same agent grants decisive capacity and arrests its exercise. Hand-as-power, temporal succession, intentional action, and penetrating awareness make the non-use of force an accountable exercise of power rather than evidence that power was absent.

activation_trace.role: Literal withholding and pushing back supplies the brake applied to both directions of attack.
The hand as strength and capacity turns the mirrored limbs into two live powers, not merely two body parts.
Succession after a prior event makes restraint follow empowerment and blocks an inability reading.
Prevailing over an opponent supplies the real dominance whose exercise is then withheld.
Purposive action lets refraining under command count within the field of deliberate deeds.
Penetrating inward knowledge places both visible blows and withheld intentions within divine awareness.

changed_reading.before: God stopped two parties from fighting after one side happened to gain the upper hand.
changed_reading.after: God first makes dominance real and then governs its non-use; restraint after capacity becomes a deliberate deed seen through, not a failure to achieve victory.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The syntax mirrors their hands away from you with your hands away from them under one restraining verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: A split hand inventory allows force, aid, and a guarding barrier to coexist. Once each vector is withheld, each side's hand ceases to be only a threat and becomes, by its non-striking, a barrier preserving the body opposite it.

activation_trace.role: Prevention converts active attack vectors into maintained limits.
The alternate hand mapping supplies a guarding barrier, giving positive protective content to non-action.
The helping hand supplies support and prevention of wrong as a live alternative to the weaponized hand.

changed_reading.after: The neutralization is a two-sided shield: each hand, by not striking, protects the person it could have harmed, so restraint itself performs aid.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restraining verb, the paired literal hands, the interior of Mecca, and the granted hold over the opponents form one spatial chain.
baseline_models.mechanism: Closure, encirclement, bodily interior, and an embedded claw organize the scene as nested containment. The city's inner cavity contains confronting bodies, while the restraining action closes around the very hands that have gained the ability to penetrate.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and closure supplies an enclosing operation rather than only a command to desist.
A group circling an object supplies the perimeter around the face-to-face encounter.
The inside, underside, or cavity makes the city location function as the scene's containing chamber.
Literal hands keep the spatial model attached to bodily contact rather than an abstract enclosure.
A claw lodging in material supplies the unrealized penetration that the enclosure arrests.

changed_reading.before: A ceasefire happens at a geographic place in central Mecca.
changed_reading.after: The city interior acts as a containing chamber: confronting hands are enclosed just when a claw-like hold becomes possible, yielding possession without penetration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restraint follows achieved prevalence, so the focus itself raises the question of how much victory is enough.
baseline_models.mechanism: The packet's non-dominant sufficiency mapping and the restraint inventory's no-surplus and equivalence images create a threshold model. Once decisive access has been granted, further hand-action is excess rather than completion; the alternate mapping activates an image without replacing the focus verb's morphology.

activation_trace.role: Carrying an affair until sufficiency supplies the threshold at which further force is no longer needed.
Enough provision without excess supplies a no-surplus measure for the use of victory.
Fit and equivalence supply calibrated proportionality instead of maximal extraction.
Actual prevalence establishes that the stopping point is chosen after success, not imposed by failure.

changed_reading.before: Victory is interrupted before it can be fully cashed out.
changed_reading.after: Victory reaches its proper measure precisely when decisive control is enough and surplus injury is withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's opening names an opening that is itself victory and disclosure. Read back into the focus, the apparent paradox becomes functional: closing the routes of reciprocal violence is one way the promised opening becomes manifest.

activation_trace.role: Opening as prevalence supplies the context's category for a success that need not be a breached body or city.
Emergence into visibility makes the nonviolent outcome legible as disclosed success rather than concealed failure.
Closure supplies the surprising operation through which the larger opening can be enacted.
Granted prevalence keeps the opening-by-closure model anchored in real victory.

structural_cues: 48:1 intensifies opening through a verb plus cognate noun and marks the result as manifest.
48:24 places restraint after granted prevalence, joining an opening outcome to a closing operation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: opening can image prevalence and disclosure, while the focus supplies closure after prevalence. Reader arrow: the closure of violence realizes the opening rather than interrupting it. Live alternative: the opening may denote a separate event whose language only echoes the focus.

changed_reading.before: Opening is the result of victory, while restraint is a later interruption of it.
changed_reading.after: The clear opening can take the form of closure: reciprocal hands are shut down, and that non-breach is itself a disclosed victory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated cessation of motion descends into believers, while the later scene opposes heated group pride to descended stillness and protective adherence. The focus's stopped hands become the outward kinematics of governed inner motion; its bilateral surface can coexist with asymmetric interior states.

activation_trace.role: Cessation of movement supplies an inward prototype for the later arrest of hands.
The repeated loss of agitation immediately before a near opening makes stillness productive rather than inert.
Heated pride and anger supply the affective pressure that could otherwise discharge through hands.
Motion dying down counterposes a cooled interior state to heated agitation.
Protection from harm gives the settled state a guarding function rather than mere calmness.
Withholding supplies the bodily endpoint of the context's regulation of motion and heat.
Hand-as-force identifies what outward capacity is prevented from carrying inner agitation into impact.

structural_cues: Stillness descends repeatedly in 48:4, 48:18, and 48:26, and the last occurrence is set against doubled heated pride.
48:24 renders the resulting arrest symmetrically at the level of hands even though 48:26 distinguishes the groups' inner states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: recurrent stillness removes motion, heated pride supplies agitation, protection supplies a guarded state, and the focus arrests hand-force. Reader arrow: inward regulation propagates outward into restrained action. Live alternative: the hand-restraint may be wholly external intervention with no psychological causal path.

changed_reading.before: Both sides are symmetrically restrained by an external tactical intervention.
changed_reading.after: The outward symmetry contains an inward asymmetry: heated pride presses toward discharge while descended stillness becomes protective control of hand-power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier vertical arrangement of a divine hand above pledged human hands is rotated into the focus's horizontal reciprocity. A hand placed under higher authority demonstrates the pledge not only by what it does, but by refusing autonomous force when that authority restrains it.

activation_trace.role: A pledge of obedience supplies the prior commitment governing the later use of hand-power.
The yielded hand of obedience and guarantee gives the stacked hands a covenantal function.
The same obedient-hand image makes the believers' restrained hand a performed pledge rather than forced passivity.
Prevention supplies the command boundary within which pledged obedience is tested.
Intentional action allows covenant fidelity to be expressed as chosen non-use of force.

structural_cues: 48:10 stacks one divine hand above plural human hands; 48:24 mirrors two plural hand groups across reciprocal prepositional phrases.
Both scenes place divine agency over the meaning and permitted use of human hands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: pledge, yielded hand, and the focus's restrained paired hands are explicit. Reader arrow: the earlier pledge governs the later refusal to strike. Live alternative: the hand imagery may mark protection or power in both places without establishing a covenantal causal link.

changed_reading.before: The believers' hands are restrained in the same tactical way as their opponents' hands.
changed_reading.after: Their restraint also verifies the pledge: the hand under higher authority proves fidelity by declining to act as an autonomous weapon.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier instance of the same restraint-hand formula shields the believers from other people's hands and is called a sign on a guided, straight path. The focus repeats that protection but adds the believers' hands in the opposite direction, turning unilateral safety into a reciprocal limit on the newly protected side.

activation_trace.role: The earlier act of prevention establishes the exact protective operation later expanded in the focus.
Other people's hand-force supplies the one-way threat vector in the first formula.
A visible sign makes restraint evidentiary, something meant to redirect perception and conduct.
Gentle direction toward a way turns the protective event into guidance for later behavior.
The straight road supplies the behavioral course on which restraint is read as guidance.
Straightness and balanced alignment make reciprocity a completion of the earlier one-sided protection.
The repeated prevention now governs both directional clauses.
Paired hand-powers complete the earlier single threat vector as a reciprocal ethical geometry.

structural_cues: 48:20 has one restrained vector, other people's hands away from the believers; 48:24 repeats it and adds the believers' hands away from them.
The earlier formula is followed by sign, guidance, path, and straightness language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an exact one-way restraint formula is followed by guidance language, and the focus expands the formula to two directions. Reader arrow: the second use completes the lesson of the first by limiting the beneficiaries as well as their attackers. Live alternative: the two restraints may be independent protections with no ethical escalation.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports a balanced ceasefire in isolation.
changed_reading.after: The focus completes an earlier shield: protection becomes straight guidance only when those protected also accept a limit on their own newly available force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding context contrasts human inability with divine encompassing control. The focus then grants human prevalence but encloses its hands inside the city's interior, so capability itself appears as a bounded region within a larger perimeter rather than an autonomous possession.

activation_trace.role: Effective capacity to act and possess supplies the contrast between human inability and divinely granted ability.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and control supplies the larger perimeter around human capability.
A containing rim or receptacle supplies a local bound around the hands that could act.
The city interior nests the human encounter inside the larger field of encompassing control.
Real prevalence shows that the inner region contains granted power, not merely powerlessness.

structural_cues: 48:21 places human non-capacity and divine encompassing in one contrast.
48:24 moves from granted prevalence to bounded hands within a named interior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: humans cannot reach one object already encompassed by God, while the focus grants and then restrains another capacity. Reader arrow: both inability and ability are variable regions inside one controlling perimeter. Live alternative: the two verses concern separate objects and need not imply a shared spatial model.

changed_reading.before: Human victory is achieved locally and then checked by a separate divine command.
changed_reading.after: Human capacity never exits divine containment: the perimeter can grant access, define its measure, and close the hand without turning victory into defeat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding conditional supplies a decisive battle outcome without requiring that battle to occur: opponents would turn away and find no supporting protector. The focus can therefore name granted prevalence as real control of the outcome while restraint keeps that outcome from being executed through killing.

activation_trace.role: Mutual combat supplies the unrealized condition whose result is nevertheless specified.
Protective alliance and aid supply what the predicted losers would fail to find.
Turning the back supplies the predicted retreat that marks decisive asymmetry.
Aid that makes a side prevail supplies the absent reinforcement in the counterfactual outcome.
Granted dominance realizes the asymmetry forecast by the conditional without demanding a body count.
Withholding prevents the known outcome from needing violent demonstration.
The after-clause locates restraint on the far side of established prevalence even if combat remains unrealized.

structural_cues: 48:22 is explicitly conditional and gives a complete result for a fight that is not asserted to occur there.
48:24 says prevalence was granted before both hand-vectors were restrained.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the conditional predicts retreat and absence of aid, and the focus states granted prevalence followed by restraint. Reader arrow: secure knowledge and control of the counterfactual outcome can constitute victory without executing it. Live alternative: a limited prior clash may be presupposed, making the prevalence partly actual rather than wholly counterfactual.

changed_reading.before: A realized clash produced victory and was then stopped.
changed_reading.after: The decisive result is made real at the level of control and counterfactual certainty, while restraint prevents victory from needing proof through killing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah supplies an intermingled population whom the acting group cannot identify, the risk of crushing or hitting them, moral contamination without knowledge, mercy, and a conditional separation that has not occurred. Divine sight at the focus's close therefore contrasts with human targeting opacity; restraint is a precision constraint on force inside a mixed interior.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure supplies the discrimination humans lack about concealed people in the target space.
Crushing pressure supplies the indiscriminate bodily harm that unseparated force could cause.
Striking a target supplies the precision problem: an intended hit can land on an unknown protected body.
A stain of harm supplies the moral residue of acting under unresolved identification.
Tender mercy supplies the protective purpose of delaying force rather than merely its tactical inconvenience.
Separation and differentiation supply the absent condition under which selective action would become possible.
A hidden interior turns the city center into an epistemically opaque target space.
Penetrating knowledge supplies the divine discrimination set against human non-knowledge.
Prevention functions as the targeting interlock while identification remains unresolved.
Literal hands keep the epistemic constraint attached to actual bodily force.
Purposive action makes responsibility depend on what actors do under known limits of discrimination.

structural_cues: 48:25 twice foregrounds human non-knowledge and makes harm conditional on an unrecognized mixed population.
The punitive alternative is also conditional on prior separation, while 48:24 closes with unrestricted divine sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: unknown protected people, crushing and target impact, stain without knowledge, mercy, and unrealized separation are explicit. Reader arrow: these details make restraint a discrimination threshold for force. Live alternative: the primary mechanism may be protection of sanctuary and offering, with hidden persons as one additional reason.

changed_reading.before: The reciprocal halt is a general act of mercy or treaty-making.
changed_reading.after: The halt is also a precision rule: inside a mixed and hidden population, force is disabled because human hands cannot distinguish their legitimate target from protected life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later pairing of sufficiency with witnessing closes a circuit already latent in the focus's alternate restraint mapping and final divine sight. If the decisive reality is sufficiently witnessed, dominance does not need bodily demonstration; withheld action can carry the proof that violent spectacle would otherwise claim to provide.

activation_trace.role: An affair carried through to sufficiency supplies the claim that no further evidentiary action is needed.
The packet's reverse split mapping links sufficiency back to prevention without collapsing the two lexical forms.
Present witnessing supplies an adequate register of what occurred without public violence as proof.
The focus root's sufficiency target lets prevention be heard as stopping at an adequate measure.
Unobstructed sight supplies the witnessing capacity that makes visible injury unnecessary as evidence.
Intentional deeds include the witnessed choice not to turn prevalence into spectacle.
Actual dominance supplies the fact that requires witness but not violent reenactment.

structural_cues: 48:24 ends with divine sight of action; 48:28 ends with divine sufficiency as witness.
The packet maps the focus restraint root toward sufficiency and the later sufficiency root back toward prevention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: divine sight, sufficient witnessing, granted prevalence, and a bidirectional split mapping between restraint and sufficiency are present. Reader arrow: adequate witness replaces the need to prove victory through injury. Live alternative: both endings may be independent doxological assurances rather than a theory of nonviolent evidence.

changed_reading.before: Divine sight merely records whether the restrained parties obey.
changed_reading.after: Divine sight is itself sufficient witness to the achieved victory, allowing restrained non-action to replace violent demonstration as its proof.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final plant sequence converts force into a developmental process: a shoot emerges, supports and is supported, thickens, and stands, while the resulting anger remains affect in the observer. This activates the focus's helping-hand branch so that withheld striking power is not idle but redirected into mutual support and durable growth.

activation_trace.role: Cultivated emergence and growth supplies the non-combat domain into which communal power can be redirected.
A shoot emerging beside its root supplies new life that strengthens through relation rather than attack.
Plants stiffening through mutual support supplies the causal conversion from hand-force to collective reinforcement.
Thickening after thinness supplies strength as accumulated growth rather than inflicted damage.
Rising and settling upright supplies the stable result of supported growth.
Anger held in the chest supplies charged opposition that need not be answered by reciprocal impact.
The helping hand supplies the focus anchor for converting hand-power from striking to mutual reinforcement.
Withholding blocks the violent channel so capacity can take the developmental channel instead.
Purposive work keeps the growth model attached to an alternative mode of action rather than mere passivity.

structural_cues: 48:29 gives a strict developmental sequence from shoot to support to thickness to uprightness, followed by the opponents' anger.
48:24 has already separated possession of hand-power from its discharge as reciprocal violence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: plant growth, mutual support, thickening, uprightness, latent anger, helping hands, and withheld force are supplied. Reader arrow: blocked striking capacity is redirected into collective cultivation. Live alternative: the plant similitude may describe communal formation independently of the focus's restrained hands.

changed_reading.before: Restrained hands are temporarily idle weapons.
changed_reading.after: Their strength can be rerouted into supportive work that thickens and steadies a community, while hostile anger is left contained rather than answered hand for hand.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates concrete claw branches inside a verb of prevailing. It remains valid as a material analogy because the same focus places that root beside literal hands and an explicit restraining operation. Downstream prose should mark it as an image of controlled capacity, not as a replacement gloss for victory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The prevalence root sits between paired hands and their restraint, allowing the packet's claw and embedding branches to model what those hands are prevented from doing.

activation_trace.role: The claw supplies a bodily implement of dominance contiguous with the focus's literal hands.
A claw sinking into material supplies the unrealized injury-path of achieved dominance.
Withholding arrests the claw before capacity becomes penetration.
Literal hands keep the claw analogy attached to the focus's bodily scene.

changed_reading.before: God enabled victory and then stopped further combat.
changed_reading.after: God grants a claw-like hold yet keeps it from sinking in: the victory is real precisely as controlled, unspent penetration.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it links an eye membrane and sight-withholding branches to a victory construction. It remains anchored through the focus's prevalence root, restraining root, literal hand imagery, and final divine sight. Downstream prose should present it as a perceptual warning generated by the branch field, not as philological identity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves from restraint through prevalence to an all-seeing close, while both the restraint and prevalence inventories contain unusual visual branches.

activation_trace.role: A membrane covering the eye supplies the possibility that triumph itself clouds human perception.
The eye's encounter with what it sees supplies a second visual edge within the prevalence root.
Withheld sight supplies perceptual closure as a danger parallel to withheld hands.
A hand shading the brow in order to discern supplies restraint as a condition for clearer looking.
Unobstructed eyesight supplies the clear divine seeing against which victory-clouded human sight is measured.

changed_reading.before: The closing sight formula only states surveillance of conduct.
changed_reading.after: It also contains a perceptual reversal: prevalence can film over human sight, while restraining the hand creates distance for discernment under unobstructed divine seeing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines bodily-interior, womb, separation, and shoot imagery into a gestational model of the city. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit interior location and restraint, then gains concrete support from the concealed mixed population and later emergence imagery. Downstream prose should call it a cross-domain spatial analogy, not claim that the place-name construction literally means pregnancy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The encounter occurs in the city's interior while hands are restrained, and the next ayah reveals concealed lives that have not yet been differentiated from the surrounding population.

activation_trace.role: An inner cavity that can contain a fetus supplies the gestational geometry of the city interior.
Prevention supplies the protective suspension around life hidden in that interior.
Undisclosed knowledge supplies concealed identities not yet available to human discrimination.
The womb branch supplies a contained-life image activated by mercy in the concealed population scene.
Differentiation supplies the not-yet-completed emergence of protected lives from the mixed interior.
A new shoot emerging around its root supplies a later organic image for protected future appearance.

changed_reading.before: The city interior is only the location where mutual violence is halted.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a gestational enclosure: force is suspended around concealed life until differentiation and later emergence can occur.

strongest_changes: The one-way protective restraint of 48:20 becomes reciprocal in 48:24, making guided protection include a limit on the protected side's own force.
The concealed mixed population of 48:25 turns restraint into an epistemic precision rule: no force while protected and target bodies cannot be distinguished.
The heat and repeated stillness sequence culminates in stopped hands, allowing external symmetry and internal asymmetry to coexist.
The sufficient witness of 48:28 changes divine sight from passive surveillance into an alternative to proving victory through bodily harm.
The conditional battle outcome of 48:22 allows prevalence to be real as control without requiring its execution through killing.
summary.what_was_special: The focus concentrates a paradox: one divine agency grants prevalence, restrains both sides, locates them inside an interior, and sees their intentional action. Split mappings keep several live mechanisms together, including protection, no-surplus sufficiency, containment, claw control, and perceptual correction, without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The arrow from descended inner stillness to outwardly stopped hands is abductive; direct external restraint remains live.
The opening-by-closure model may describe the focus itself or only resonate with a distinct opening elsewhere in the surah.
The prevalence may be wholly counterfactual control or may presuppose a limited actual encounter.
The sufficiency, visual, ecological, and gestational activations depend on packet-supported branch crossings and should remain explicitly exploratory where marked.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Reciprocal restraint after capability.** `كف` anchors ك ف ف B002; repeated `أيدي` anchors ي د ي B001 and B009; `أظفركم` anchors ظ ف ر B001 (victorious prevailing). The temporal `من بعد` makes restraint follow, not precede, prevalence. I infer that withheld action is chosen under capability rather than imposed by weakness. Victory reads as mastery sufficient to stop both hands.
2. **Palms withheld by a withholding act.** ك ف ف B001 is the palm and B002 is withholding; their material overlap is activated by the repeated hands. I infer that the root-image turns restraint into a hand acting upon hands, a precise bodily mechanism. This strengthens the reading of divine governance as controlled closure rather than diffuse protection.
3. **Hidden interior under complete sight.** `بطن` anchors ب ط ن B001 (inside/belly) and B002 (hidden inward reality); `بصيرًا` anchors ب ص ر B001 (eye-sight) and B002 (inner sight). The city’s interior and the agents’ deeds occupy nested hidden spaces. I infer that sight reaches both location and motive. The restraint is situated in a concealed interior but not epistemically obscure.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 48:25 reveals the hidden cause of the restraint: unknown believers could be trampled and transfer a moral stain. What looked like bilateral control in 48:24 becomes precise protection of unseen persons.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Victory realized as controlled non-strike.** Fixed `كَفَّ` anchors ك ف ف `B002`, withholding and restraining; doubled `أَيْدِي` anchors the bodily hand in ي د ي `B001`; `أَظْفَرَكُمْ` anchors ظ ف ر `B001`, victorious prevailing. The syntax explicitly places mutual restraint *after* capacity to prevail, and 48:25 then discloses the unknown believers who could have been harmed. The packet supplies capacity, restraint, and protected objects; I infer **prevailing capacity + informed restraint -> a higher-order victory that preserves rather than spends power**. Victory shifts from striking to governable non-striking.

2. **The city's belly as a hidden social interior.** Fixed `بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ` anchors ب ط ن `B001`, the inside or belly of a thing, and `B002`, hidden inward reality. Ayah 48:25 populates that interior with believing men and women unknown to the addressed group; fixed `بَصِيرًا` activates ب ص ر `B002`, inner sight. The packet supplies location, hidden occupants, and superior sight; I infer **mixed concealed interior -> need for sight-guided hand restraint**. `بِبَطْنِ` becomes causally relevant spatial information, not a neutral place-name adjunct.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 48:25 supplied the concealed occupants of fixed `ببطن مكة` and thereby explained both bilateral restraint and the need for inner sight. It changed victory retrospectively from unused striking capacity into preservation of a mixed interior.

baseline.text: Sizi onlara üstün getirdikten sonra Mekke'nin ortasında onların ellerini sizden, sizin ellerinizi de onlardan çeken O'dur. Allah yaptıklarınızı görmektedir.

findings.text: Karşılıklı ellerin üstünlük sağlandıktan sonra tutulması, zaferi gücü harcamak yerine onu denetleyip koruma sağlayabilmek olarak yeniden tanımlar.
Mekke'nin içi, bilinmeyen insanların karışık hâlde bulunduğu gizli bir toplumsal iç mekândır; bu nedenle el kısıtlaması içgörüyle yönetilir.
Avuç ile alıkoyma anlamlarının aynı kökte buluşması, elleri durduran eylemi sanki bir elin eller üzerine kapanması gibi somutlaştırabilir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2: Restrained Force and Enclosed Capacity
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Effective power may be fully present while held inside a boundary that prevents premature contact.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Restraint is not impotence: palm, hand-force, enclosure, care, and capacity depict force as deliberately contained and preserved.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hands Arrested Before Contact
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A capable hand reaches the edge of action but is checked before force passes into another body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: palm (`quranic:root_001308:B001/m01`); restraint (`quranic:root_001308:B002/m01`); hand (`quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`); force or capacity of the hand (`quranic:root_001693:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 48:20 `كف` and `أيدي` (ك ف ف; ي د ي); 48:24 `كف`, `أيديهم`, and `أيديكم` (ك ف ف; ي د ي).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The palm gives the force an embodied endpoint, and restraint arrests that endpoint before impact. The hand remains capable, so non-contact appears as controlled power rather than absence of power.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2: Protected Interior and Differentiated Contact
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A concealed interior remains protected when indistinguishable persons are separated before force can strike them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The city's interior and the womb-like register of mercy make hidden persons components of a protected interior rather than incidental obstacles.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Concealed Human Interior
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Persons remain unseen within an interior that receives entry into protective mercy.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: belly or interior (`quranic:root_000128:B001/m01`); hidden interior (`quranic:root_000128:B002/m01`); tender protective mercy (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); womb (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); entry (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); men (`quranic:root_000546:B002/m01`); women (`quranic:root_001500:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 48:24 `ببطن` (ب ط ن); 48:25 `رجال`, `ونساء`, `يدخل`, and `رحمته` (ر ج ل; ن س و; د خ ل; ر ح م).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The belly-root spatializes the city's hidden interior, while the womb sense of mercy makes protection generative and enclosing. Men and women are the concealed occupants whose unknown presence governs whether force may enter.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insan elinin avuç ve parmaklarla birlikte kavrayıp açılan bölümünü temel alır; kuşun tuttuğunu kavradığı organı da buna bağlı bir kullanım olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve bu çekirdek ile kuşa özgü uzantıyı doğru biçimde ayırmaktadır.

concept_map.definition: İnsanda, parmaklarla birlikte nesneyi kavramaya ve eli açmaya yarayan el içidir. Kuş söz konusu olduğunda, tuttuğu şeyi kavrayan ayak bölümü için buna benzetilerek kullanılır.

facets.statement: İnsan elinin parmaklarla birlikte kavrama ve açma işini yapan iç bölümüdür.
Kuş bağlamında, ele benzer biçimde tuttuğunu kavrayan ayak bölümünü belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insan avucunu kavrama ve açma işleviyle tanımlar; kuşun avını kavrayan organını da aynı tasarıma bağlı olarak anar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem kişinin bir işten geri durmasını hem de başkasını bir işten alıkoyup geri çevirmesini açıkça içerir. Yinelemeli biçim aynı geri çevirme işlemini güçlendirir; gözyaşını tutma ise bu çekirdeğin belirli bir nesneyle kurulan kullanımıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir eylemi sürdürmeyip ondan geri durmak veya bir kişiyi ya da şeyi ilerlediği yönden alıkoyup geri çevirmektir. Aynı işlem gözyaşını akmaktan tutma gibi belirli bağlamlarda da gerçekleşir.

facets.statement: Kişi bir işi yapmaktan kendi isteğiyle ya da bir engel sonucu geri durur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar geri durma, başkasını engelleme ve bir şeyi geri çevirme anlamlarını ortak bir durdurma çekirdeğinde birleştirir; gözyaşını tutma bunun özel uygulamasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesindeki toplama, çevresini sarma, bağlayıp kapatma ve içindekinin üzerine kapatma örnekleri ortak bir çevreleme ve tutma işlemi oluşturur. Közün odunlarla çevrilmesi ve kötülüğün kapalı tutulması da bu işlemin uygulamalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek yalnız yan yana toplama değil, çevreleme yoluyla içeride tutma veya kapatmadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel toplama ve çevrelemeyi, bezle sarma ve kabı bağlayıp kapatma söz öbeklerinden ayrı katmanlarda verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bir araya toplamak veya çevresine başka bir şey getirerek onu kuşatıp içeride tutmaktır. Bezle sarma ve bir kabı içindekilerin üzerine kapatıp bağlama bu işlemin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şey toplanır ya da çevresi sarılarak kuşatılır ve tutulur.
Bir nesnenin çevresine bez getirilerek nesne sarılır.
Bir kap, içindekilerin üzerine kapatılıp sıkıca bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı toplama, etrafına bir malzeme koyma, közleri çevreleme ve içi dolu kabı bağlayıp kapatma örneklerini ortak bir çevreleyerek tutma işleminde birleştirir; kötülüğün kapalı tutulmasını da kabı kapatmaya benzetilen ilişkili bir uygulama olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Toplama, sarma ve içindekini tutacak biçimde kapatma aşamalarının ortak çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Toplama, çevreleme, sarma ve bağlayıp kapatma işlemlerinin tamamını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi giysi, kum, diş eti ve bulutun kenarları ile dağın çıkıntılı yanlarını aynı çevresel uç veya sınır tasarımında toplar. Giysi kenarlarını dikme eylemi de bu sınıra yönelik ilişkili bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız belirtilen tamlamalarda gerçekleşir; her nesnenin genel kenarı için yalın bir anlam kurulamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım giysi, kum, diş eti, bulut ve dağla kurulan söz öbeklerine bağlıdır ve yalın köke genellenmez.

facets.statement: Belirtilen nesnenin çevresinde veya yanında bulunan kenar ve sınır bölümünü gösterir.

Diş eti eteği, bulut ve kum kıyısı ile dağın çıkıntılı sırtları için kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar giysi, kum, diş eti, bulut ve dağla kurulan kullanımları çevresel kenar veya çıkıntılı yan ortaklığında toplar; giysi kenarını dikme de bu alanla ilişkilidir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Giysi veya gömleğin etek çevresini ve dikilen kenarını anlatan söz öbeklerinde uygundur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi terazide tartılanı taşıyan göz, avı çevreleyen halka biçimli tuzak ve fırlatma aracının yük yuvasını içeren söz öbeklerini verir. Bunları birleştiren unsur, yuvarlak veya çanak biçimli olup içindekini taşıma ya da çevreleme işlevidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnız belirtilen araç adlarıyla kurulan söz öbeklerine aittir; genel bir kap adı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım terazi, avcı tuzağı ve fırlatma aracıyla kurulan söz öbekleriyle sınırlıdır ve yalın anlama genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli araç adlarıyla kurulan söz öbeklerinde, yuvarlak ya da çanak biçimiyle bir şeyi taşıyan veya çevreleyip tutan bölümdür. Terazinin gözü, halka biçimli av tuzağı ve fırlatma aracının yük yuvası bu kapsamdadır.

facets.statement: Yuvarlak veya çanak biçimli bir araç bölümü içindekini taşır ya da çevreleyerek tutar.
Terazide tartılan nesnenin konduğu taşıyıcı gözü belirtir.
Av tuzağının halka biçimli bölümü ile fırlatma aracının yük yuvasını belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar terazi gözünü, avı çevreleyen halka biçimli tuzağı ve fırlatma aracının yük yuvasını, taşıyan veya çevreleyip tutan yuvarlak biçim ortaklığında anar.

concept_gloss.text: taşıyan veya çevreleyen yuvarlak araç bölümü
concept_gloss.applicability: Terazi, tuzak ve fırlatma aracıyla kurulan söz öbeklerinin ortak biçim ve işlevini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Çanak veya halka biçimini, taşıma ve çevreleyip tutma işlevlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tartılacak nesnenin konduğu terazi bölümü söz konusu olduğunda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: İçine tartılacak şey konan çanak biçimli taşıyıcı bölümü korur.
error_profile.loses: Halka biçimli av tuzağını ve fırlatma aracının yük yuvasını kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal av tuzağının yanı sıra terazi gözünü ve fırlatma aracının yük yuvasını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal tuzak kurma, av yakalama ve mecazlaşmış tuzak nedenleri gibi daha geniş bir avlama alanına yayılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da av hayvanını yakalayan çevreleyici tuzak bölümünde kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda tuzak yalnız yuvarlak ve çevreleyici araç parçası anlamının bir gerçekleşmesidir. Komşu dalın çekirdeği ise biçimden bağımsız olarak tuzak ve av yakalama düzenidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar değerlendirildi; av tuzağı komşusu ortak nesneyi paylaşırken bu dalın biçim ve araç parçası sınırını en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: كفّة الميزان وكفّة الصائد أو الحبالة وما يشبه الوعاء أو الطوق الذي يحوي ما فيه
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست حاشية الثوب ولا كفاف الرزق ولا كف اليد
branches.source_phrase_ar: كل ما استدار فهو كفة نحو كفة الميزان وكفة الصائد (maqayis)؛ كفة الميزان التي توضع فيها الدراهم والكفة ما يصاد به الظبي (ayn)؛ كفة الميزان والمنجنيق (jamhara)؛ كفة الميزان وكفة الصائد وهي حبالته (sihah)؛ كفة الحبالة يجعل كالطوق (tahdhib)؛ كفة الميزان تشبيه بالكف وكذا كفة الحبالة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir insan topluluğunun tamamını, herkesin dahil oluşunu ve bir işin bütün bölümlerini eksiksiz kapsamayı bildirir. Topluluğun kendisi için kullanılan adlandırma da bu tam kapsama anlamına bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek sayı veya çokluk değil, belirlenen topluluğun ya da bütünün hiçbir parçasını dışarıda bırakmamaktır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam çözümlenmemiştir; tanım bu nedenle yalın kök anlamı varsaymadan yalnız kanıtlanan tam kapsama kullanımlarını verir.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir topluluğun bütün üyelerini veya bir işin bütün bölümlerini hiçbirini dışarıda bırakmadan kapsama anlamıdır. Aynı biçim, tamamı birlikte düşünülen topluluğu da adlandırabilir.

facets.statement: Bir topluluğun bütün üyeleri eksiksiz biçimde kapsama alınır.
Bir işin veya düzenin bütün bölümleri aynı eksiksiz kapsama içinde düşünülür.
Tamamı birlikte düşünülen insan topluluğu bu kapsam özelliğiyle adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insan topluluğunun tüm üyelerini ve bir işin bütün bölümlerini eksiksiz kapsama anlamında birleşir; bu bütünlüğü taşıyan topluluğu da adlandırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsanların tamamını veya bir işin bütün parçalarını dışarıda bırakmadan kuşatan kullanımları karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Tamlık, eksiksiz dahil etme ve bütün topluluğu adlandırma yönlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insan topluluğunun bütün üyelerinin dahil edildiği bağlamlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluktaki hiçbir kişiyi dışarıda bırakmayan tam kapsamı korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir işin bütün bölümlerini kapsama ve topluluğun kendisini adlandırma kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal insan topluluğu dışında bir işin bütün bölümlerini de eksiksiz kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle büyük bir topluluğun seçkin veya sıradan ayrımı olmadan hep birlikte gelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir insan topluluğunda hiç kimsenin dışarıda kalmadığı tamlığı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel bir tam kapsama işlevi taşır ve insan dışındaki bütünlere de uzanır. Komşu dal ise belirli bir topluluğun bütün katmanlarıyla birlikte bulunmasına bağlı daha dar bir anlatımdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı incelendi; topluluğun eksiksiz gelişi komşusu ortak tamlık çekirdeğini paylaşırken odak dalın daha geniş kapsama alanını belirginleştirir.
branches.what_is_ar: الكافة والجميع والإحاطة بالناس أو الأمر كله
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست كف اليد ولا كفاف الرزق ولا المنع إلا حيث صرحت المصادر بذلك
branches.source_phrase_ar: الناس كافة كلهم داخل فيه (ayn)؛ الكافة الجميع من الناس (sihah)؛ كافة بمعنى الجميع والإحاطة (tahdhib)؛ ادخلوا في السلم كله أي في جميع شرائعه (tahdhib)؛ الجماعة يقال لهم الكافة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi geçinmeye yetecek besin veya harcamayı, fazlası bulunmaması koşuluyla tanımlar. Bu miktarın kişiyi başkalarından istemeye muhtaç bırakmaması sonucu da anlamın kurucu sınırıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Salt yeterlilik değil, geçimi sağlayan, fazlası olmayan ve başkasından istemeyi önleyen ölçü söz konusudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın geçimlik miktar anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve kenar, bütünlük veya başka söz öbeği anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Geçimi sağlayan, fakat ihtiyaçtan fazla olmayan besin veya harcama miktarıdır; kişiyi başkalarından istemeye muhtaç bırakmayacak kadar yeterlidir.

facets.statement: Besin veya harcama geçimi sürdürmeye yetecek miktardadır.
Bu yeterli miktarda ihtiyaç üstü bir fazlalık bulunmaz.
Yeterli geçimlik kişiyi başkalarından istemek zorunda kalmaktan korur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar geçimlik besin veya harcamanın ihtiyacı karşılayıp fazlalık bırakmamasını ve kişiyi başkasından istemekten korumasını birlikte belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yeterlilik, geçim alanı, fazlasızlık ve başkasından istemeyi önleme koşullarını birlikte taşır.

error_profile.preserves: Geçime yeter olmayı, fazlasızlığı ve istemeye muhtaç bırakmama sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Besin veya harcamanın ihtiyacı tam karşılayıp artmadığı günlük bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Geçim yeterliliğini, fazlasızlığı ve başkasına muhtaç olmama sınırını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yeterli geçimliğin ihtiyaç üstü hiçbir fazlası olmaması ve istemeyi önlemesi koşulunu taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yaşamı sürdürmeye yeten araç veya miktarı daha genel biçimde anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin yaşamını sürdürmesine yetecek geçim aracını veya miktarını gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalda genel yeterlilik belirleyicidir. Odak dalda ise yeterliliğin yanı sıra fazlasızlık ve başkasından istemeye gerek bırakmama sınırı zorunludur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel geçim yeterliliği komşusu, bu dalın fazlasızlık ve istemeyi önleme koşullarını en iyi ayırır.
branches.what_is_ar: الكفاف من النفقة أو الرزق والقوت الذي لا فضل فيه ويكف الوجه عن سؤال الناس
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس كافّة بمعنى الجميع ولا كف اليد ولا كفّة الميزان
branches.source_phrase_ar: كفاف الرزق القوت وهو ما كف عن الناس (sihah)؛ نفقته الكفاف أي ليس فيها فضل (tahdhib)؛ ما يكف وجهه عن الناس (tahdhib)؛ لا تلام على كفاف (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi görme yetisinin gitmesini ve bu yetiyi yitirmiş kişiyi açıkça bildirir. Görmenin tutulması biçimindeki açıklama sonuç olarak körlüğe işaret eder; bakmak için eli göze siper etme anlamıyla karıştırılmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal geçici bakış engelini değil, görme yetisinin yitmesini ve bu durumdaki kişiyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, görme yetisini yitirmiş kişi biçimini görmenin gitmesini bildiren söz öbeğinden ayırarak birlikte kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin görme yetisinin gitmesi veya kişinin bu yetiyi yitirmiş durumda olmasıdır.

facets.statement: Kişinin görme yetisi ortadan kalkar.
Görme yetisini yitirmiş kişi bu durum üzerinden nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar görme yetisinin gitmesini ve bu yetiyi yitirmiş kişiyi aynı durumun eylem ve kişi odaklı anlatımları olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem görmenin gitmesi olayını hem de bu durumdaki kişinin nitelenmesini temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Görme yetisinin kaybını ve bu kayıpla nitelenen kişiyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Görme yetisini yitirmiş kişinin güncel ve doğal biçimde nitelenmesinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Görme yetisi bulunmayan kişinin durumunu saygılı ve doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Görme yetisinin gitmesi olayını eylem olarak anlatmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin görme yetisini yitirmiş olmasını temel anlam olarak paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İki gözde görme yetisinin yitmesi çekirdeği olağan kullanımda tam olarak örtüşür. Kişi ve olay biçimleri ile kör görünme davranışı gibi bağımlı kullanımlar bu çekirdek sınırı değiştirmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; doğrudan körlük komşusu çekirdeğe en çok yaklaşırken ek davranış kullanımı nedeniyle tam eşleşmez.
branches.what_is_ar: المكفوف والأعمى وذهاب البصر أو قبضه عن النظر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس تكفف السائل ولا استكفاف النظر تحت الكف
branches.source_phrase_ar: المكفوف الأعمى (maqayis;tahdhib)؛ المكفوف الذاهب البصر (ayn)؛ المكفوف الضرير (sihah)؛ كف بصره (sihah;tahdhib)؛ رجل مكفوف لمن قبض بصره (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi isteyen kişinin avucunu insanlara doğru açmasını, bu bedensel hareket yoluyla bir şey istemesini bildirir. Çekirdek yalnız istemek değil, isteme eyleminin eli açma biçiminde gerçekleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel istekten farklı olarak isteyen kişi elini açıp uzatarak başkalarından bir şey talep eder.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım türemiş isteme biçimini ve isteyen kişiyle kurulan el açma söz öbeğini ayrı ama aynı hareket altında tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin başkalarından bir şey isterken elini açıp onlara doğru uzatması ve bu hareketle istemesidir.

facets.statement: İsteyen kişi avucunu açıp elini başkalarına doğru uzatır.
El açma hareketi başkalarından bir şey isteme eylemini gerçekleştirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar başkalarından bir şey istemeyi, isteyen kişinin avucunu açıp elini uzatmasıyla gerçekleşen bedensel bir eylem olarak ortaklaşa tanımlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İsteme eylemi ile onu gerçekleştiren açık el hareketini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasından istemeyi, eli açmayı ve insanlara doğru uzatma biçimini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başkasından yardım veya bir şey istemenin açık el hareketiyle anlatıldığı bağlamlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: İsteme eylemini ve ona eşlik eden avucu açıp uzatma hareketini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal istemeyi avucu açıp eli insanlara uzatma biçimiyle sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şey veya bağış istemeyi belirli bir el hareketi gerektirmeden kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insanlardan bir şey talep etme eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel isteme eylemidir. Odak dalda ise talebin avucu açıp eli uzatarak yapılması kurucu bir koşuldur; bu hareket olmadan odak anlam tamamlanmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; genel isteme komşusu ortak amacı paylaşırken açık el hareketinin zorunlu olup olmadığını en açık biçimde ayırır.
